Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: isolated production animation layer for Salve, extracted/reconstructed from the supplied original illustration. Input 1 is the exact identity, style, clothing and pixel-position reference. Output one PNG with real transparent alpha, portrait 1024x1536. Keep the requested part in EXACTLY its original position and scale on that full canvas; all other regions fully transparent. Do not center or enlarge the isolated part. Preserve original fine anime linework, soft shading, proportions, white hair, black fabric and turquoise trim. Complete surfaces formerly occluded by other layers so joints can overlap when bending; no severed-body horror, no gore, this is a clean game asset. No labels, outlines, skeletons, diagrams, shadow background or extra views.
Primary request: isolate the complete clothed torso and original black/turquoise skirt ONLY, from the white collar at y390 to the original skirt hem at y1035. Preserve belt, turquoise ring, bow, dress trim. Reconstruct the black shoulders and bodice under her white hair and sleeves. Exclude head, hair, both arms, hands, legs and boots. Include opaque black fabric shoulder overlap tabs ending around x350/610 y470 so sleeves can overlap them. The dress remains one complete garment, original shape and position. Transparent everywhere else.

Asset type: eight-view orthographic character turnaround reference sheet for building a poseable 3D rig. Landscape 2048x1536 image. EXACTLY eight evenly spaced full-body standing figures in a clean 4-column by 2-row grid, each same height and scale, feet on aligned baselines with ample transparent margins. Top row, left to right: exact FRONT, FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing image-right, exact RIGHT-FACING PROFILE, BACK THREE-QUARTER facing image-right. Bottom row: exact BACK, BACK THREE-QUARTER facing image-left, exact LEFT-FACING PROFILE, FRONT THREE-QUARTER facing image-left. Keep the SAME character, dress construction, hair length and proportions in every view. Show the back of the black dress, same belt, sleeves and long hair; no invented tail or accessories. Resting arms slightly separated from body. Full head and feet visible in every cell. This is a model sheet, not sequential walking poses; no perspective camera foreshortening. Only eight characters, no text.

Asset type: isolated rear hair layer for skeletal animation. Portrait1024x1536 canvas. ONLY her long white rear hair, from crown aroundy35 down to the long curling ends aroundy820, original full widthx130..870. Reconstruct a complete continuous rear curtain of hair which was hidden behind her head, neck, torso and sleeves. No face, no eyes, no skin, no body, no clothes. Use case: precise-object-edit. The supplied image is the edit target: isolated original black/turquoise dress for Salve. Remove BOTH white sleeves completely, from shoulders to cuffs, leaving only the black sleeveless dress, white collar, black bow, belt and skirt. Keep the entire remaining dress exactly unchanged in shape, scale, location, colors, texture, trim and outline. Replace removed sleeves with genuine transparent alpha, extend black fabric by a tiny rounded seam allowance at both armholes for animation overlap. No arms, sleeves, skin, head, hair, legs, other pieces or background. Real transparent alpha background. Do not center or enlarge dress. Output a portrait1024x1536 garment-only layer. This is a clean isolated piece of clothing for a virtual wardrobe.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Extract ONLY the fully clothed lower half from this pajama character image as an isolated animation clothing layer: the complete lavender long pajama trousers and white/turquoise slippers, including an opaque high pajama waistband at top. No exposed skin anywhere. No head, torso, arms, hands, hair or shirt. Keep the trousers and slippers exactly the same design, pose, shading, positions and scale as the source. Reconstruct the part of the trousers waistband that was hidden under the pajama shirt. Full trousers and slippers only on genuine transparent alpha background, 1024x1536 portrait canvas. Do not center or enlarge the clothing; keep original lower-canvas placement.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Create an isolated long white hair back layer matching this character's original hair length, curls and soft anime linework. Only a complete curtain of long white hair, no face, eyes, body, skin, hands, clothing or other objects. The hair runs from rounded crown into long gently curling strands with a continuous white-hair center surface, so an animated head and dressed torso can be layered in front. Genuine transparent alpha outside the hair silhouette. Portrait1024x1536 canvas. Original hair color and shading; no blue lights, accessories or labels.

note: The first torso included sleeves and was replaced; generated layers require calibration and rigging, not automatic production assembly.
